::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 13th [1863]  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1863/5
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

In great haste, I enclose [£10](organizations/other_102.qmd) for this half year’s [Thorne](other_books/otherbook_275.qmd)

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

**Note:** With envelope addressed to Miss Smith/ 8 Wellington Road/ Charlton SE and postmarked Winchester 13 July and London SE 15 July 1863.
